movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Brine
movelist.effect: If the target’s Hit Points are under 50%, Brine’s Damage Base is increased to Damage Base 13 (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Mud Shot
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.effect: The user may lower its Defense by 1 Combat Stage, and gain +1 Speed Combat Stage. This is done after the triggering damage is resolved.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Move with the Five Strike
abilities.effect: The Triggering Move automatically hits 5 Times.
